lore_entries.title: FaZe Sniping is born
lore_entries.summary: FaZe starts in 2010 as FaZe Sniping, a YouTube channel posting Call of Duty trickshot clips and montages.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: Everything FaZe became started as a few kids hitting impossible shots and uploading them. Trickshots are the origin myth.

lore_entries.title: Apex joins the crew
lore_entries.summary: Apex joins in the trickshot days and becomes one of the faces and co-owners of FaZe.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: He is the thread that runs through every FaZe era, from montages to boardrooms.

lore_entries.title: The 1 Million montage
lore_entries.summary: FaZe celebrates 1M subscribers with a montage that is still the channel's most-watched video.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The kids who watched this are adults now. This is the video Ithaca is built to bring them back to.

lore_entries.title: Rug joins and FaZe goes beyond trickshots
lore_entries.summary: Rug comes up through trickshots and later turns into one of FaZe's biggest vloggers.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is when FaZe stops being just a Call of Duty clan and becomes a lifestyle and personality brand.

lore_entries.title: Banks and the business era
lore_entries.summary: Banks joins and helps push FaZe toward merch, events and business deals.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is the start of FaZe as a company, not just a channel.

lore_entries.title: FaZe goes pro
lore_entries.summary: FaZe builds competitive rosters, adding pro Call of Duty and Counter-Strike teams.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The trickshot clan proved it could win in esports, not just make montages.

lore_entries.title: Swagg gets the offer live on stream
lore_entries.summary: Swagg is recruited during the Warzone boom, with the offer happening live on stream.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe recruits in public. Earning your way in on camera is the Bow Trial in real life.

lore_entries.title: The Nuke Squad
lore_entries.summary: FaZe's Warzone squad becomes known for chasing nukes on stream during the battle royale era.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: A whole new generation found FaZe through Warzone streams rather than YouTube montages.

lore_entries.title: Snoop Dogg joins FaZe
lore_entries.summary: Snoop Dogg joins FaZe as a member and joins its board of directors in 2022.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: FaZe had crossed over into mainstream culture: gaming meets music meets celebrity.

lore_entries.title: FaZe goes public
lore_entries.summary: FaZe Holdings lists on the Nasdaq in 2022.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: A trickshot channel became a public company. Huge peak, and the hard years after it set up today's comeback story.

lore_entries.title: The new FaZe
lore_entries.summary: After its acquisition, FaZe rebuilds around a new generation of streamers and creators.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: This is FaZe's own Odyssey: coming home after years away and winning a new generation.

lore_entries.title: Your road home
lore_entries.summary: Fans old and new come back to FaZe through Ithaca: the Bard, the Oracle and the Bow Trial.
lore_entries.why_it_matters: The story keeps going, and now you're in it.
